name: Ryvester
description: Ryvester was a planet in the Meridian sector. Imperial Admiral Kosh Teradoc was presumed dead on the planet during a Wraith Squadron, a New Republic commando unit, mission in 13 ABY. Teradoc kept a personal yacht in the bay to the east of his naval base which the Wraiths stole after their mission.
lead_paragraphs: Ryvester was a planet in the Meridian sector. Imperial Admiral Kosh Teradoc was presumed dead on the planet during a Wraith Squadron, a New Republic commando unit, mission in 13 ABY.
